first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the completion decline and may also recover activation, with two inherited findings supporting early adoption gains. Verify memory_86 for downstream quality evidence and memory_73 to compare promotional pricing's qualified-revenue durability under competitive pressure. Current summaries do not establish long-term revenue effects conclusively.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding. The verified source shows completion +13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%, directly addressing both current completion and activation declines while supporting sustainable value. Promotional pricing is rejected because its +18% qualified-revenue lift came with 30-day retention down 12% and failure before first renewal. Uncertainty remains about whether the prior onboarding effect will replicate under current conditions, so an experiment is preferable to broad rollout.
